_meta.arc_convention: Each arc has typ_lh/typ_hl/max_lh/max_hl (tPLH/tPHL) exactly as printed in the datasheet, plus 'typ' and 'max' = the LARGER of LH/HL for convenience. 74F parts also carry min_lh/min_hl and max_com* (max over the commercial temperature/VCC range, which is the number to use for worst-case design).
_meta.param_convention: Memory params are objects {min:..} or {max:..} (or both) exactly as specified; access/delay/float times are max, setup/hold/pulse/cycle times are min. Datasheet symbol names that differ from the canonical ones are given in 'symbol_map'.
_meta.estimates: Keys ending in _est are NOT from a datasheet; each carries a 'basis' explaining how it was derived.
_meta.polarity_note: 181/182 datasheets name outputs by active-low data convention (F-bar, G-bar, P-bar, Cn+4). Arc values apply to the physical pins regardless of interpretation.

74LS181.source: https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/sn54ls181.pdf (TI SDLS136, Dec 1972, rev. Mar 1988, p.7; package addendum dated 14-Jun-2026)
74LS181.conditions: VCC = 5 V, TA = 25 C, CL = 15 pF, RL = 2 kOhm (TI LS test load). Typ and max both at 25 C/5 V; TI gives no max over the full 0-70 C/4.75-5.25 V range for switching.
74LS181.availability: Commercial SN74LS181N: discontinued (TI product page SN74LS181 returns 404; not listed in TI's package addendum). Fairchild/onsemi DM74LS181N: obsolete (onsemi redirects to obsoletePart). Only TI SN54LS181J / SNJ54LS181J (military, 24-pin 600-mil ceramic DIP) are listed ACTIVE (addendum 14-Jun-2026); JM38510/07801BJA is NRND. Otherwise new-old-stock / surplus only.

A/B->A=B (M=0 diff).note: A=B is open-collector; timing depends on pull-up (test RL = 2 kOhm).

AnyA/B->AnyF (M=0 sum)_est.basis: NOT in TI table (TI only gives same-bit Ai->Fi). Cross-bit path goes through the internal lookahead; conservatively set equal to A/B->Cn+4 (sum). In the 74F181 datasheet, which does list both, AnyA/B->AnyF is ~80% of A/B->Cn+4, so this is pessimistic.

AnyA/B->AnyF (M=0 diff)_est.basis: As above, set equal to A/B->Cn+4 (diff).

S0-S3->F_est.basis: NOT specified in any 181 datasheet found (TI, Fairchild DM74LS181, National/Fairchild 74F181). Logic diagram (TI p.5) shows S0-S3 entering the same first-level AND-NOR gates as A/B, so use the A/B->F/G/P/Cn+4 arc of the mode being selected INTO as the estimate (e.g. AnyA/B->AnyF_est for F, A/B->Cn+4 for Cn+4).

M->F_est.basis: NOT specified. Logic diagram: M -> inverter -> the same carry-inhibit gates that Cn drives -> output XOR, i.e. Cn->F plus one internal inverter. Conservatively set equal to Ai/Bi->Fi (sum) which is >= Cn->F.

74LS181.notes: Arcs not given by TI: A/B->Cn+4 in logic mode, any S->output, M->output, cross-bit A/B->F (estimates provided with _est). Test conditions for each mode: SUM = M=0, S0=S3=4.5V, S1=S2=0V; DIFF = M=0, S0=S3=0V, S1=S2=4.5V; logic = M=4.5V. See also 74LS181_Fairchild_DM74LS181 which gives slightly different max values for some arcs.

74LS181_Fairchild_DM74LS181.conditions: VCC = 5 V, TA = 25 C, CL = 15 pF; RL = 2 kOhm to 5 V stated for A=B. Max only (no typ given).
74LS181_Fairchild_DM74LS181.availability: DM74LS181N (24-pin 600-mil PDIP) obsolete at onsemi; NOS only.
74LS181_Fairchild_DM74LS181.notes: Differs from TI in: A/B->G diff tPHL (26 vs 32), Ai->Fi sum tPHL (25 vs 20), Ai->Fi diff tPHL (33 vs 32), logic-mode tPHL (29 vs 38). The A/B->G (sum) row's condition reads 'M, S1, S2 = GND; S1, S3 = 4.5V' (apparent typo for S0, S3). No select->output or M->output arcs.

74S181.source: https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/sn54ls181.pdf (TI SDLS136, same document as LS181, p.9)
74S181.conditions: VCC = 5 V, TA = 25 C, CL = 15 pF, RL = 280 Ohm. Typ and max at 25 C/5 V only.
74S181.availability: SN74S181 discontinued (TI product page 404); SN54S181 (military) marked NOT RECOMMENDED FOR NEW DESIGNS on ti.com and not in the current package addendum (no orderable S181 listed). NOS only.

AnyA/B->AnyF (M=0 sum)_est.basis: NOT in TI table; conservatively set equal to A/B->Cn+4 (sum). See 74LS181 note.

AnyA/B->AnyF (M=0 diff)_est.basis: NOT in TI table; set equal to A/B->Cn+4 (diff).

S0-S3->F_est.basis: NOT specified; use the A/B arc of the target mode (S enters the same first-level gates as A/B).

M->F_est.basis: NOT specified; M path = Cn->F path plus one inverter; conservatively set equal to Ai/Bi->Fi (sum).

74S181.notes: No select->output or M->output arcs in the datasheet. Same test-mode definitions as 74LS181.

74F181.source: https://dmf.unisalento.it/~panareo/Elettronica_Digitale/Data%20sheet/74f181.pdf (National Semiconductor 54F/74F181, Aug 1995, TL/F/9491, p.6). Fairchild's later DS009491 is the same datasheet lineage (Fairchild took over National's logic line); its numbers were not separately verified.
74F181.conditions: typ/max/min: TA = 25 C, VCC = 5.0 V, CL = 50 pF. max_com: TA = 0..70 C, VCC = 4.5..5.5 V, CL = 50 pF. RL is not printed in the AC table.
74F181.availability: Obsolete: onsemi 74F181PC (24-pin 600-mil PDIP) and 74F181SPC (300-mil 'slim' PDIP) both redirect to onsemi's obsolete-part page. No manufacturer currently making it found. NOS from surplus dealers (e.g. small quantities listed on rcfreelance.com).

S0-S3->F_est.basis: NOT specified in the datasheet; use the A/B arc of the target mode (S enters the same first-level gates as A/B).

M->F_est.basis: NOT specified; M path = Cn->F plus one inverter; conservatively set equal to Ai/Bi->Fi (sum).

74F181.notes: Values transcribed from the rendered table and cross-checked against the text layer. Ai/Bi->Fi (diff) tPHL typ is printed as 5.0 ns (lower than its own min-to-max neighbours suggest; recorded as printed). The table also has 54F military max values (not recorded). A=B output is open-collector. No select->output or M->output arcs. Datasheet lists commercial PDIP 'P' (600 mil) and 'SP' (slim 300 mil) packages.

AS6C62256-55.conditions: Single AC table valid over VCC 2.7-5.5 V. Input pulse 0.2 V to VCC-0.2 V, 3 ns rise/fall, 1.5 V reference, load CL = 50 pF + 1 TTL (IOH/IOL = -1/2 mA). tCLZ/tOLZ/tCHZ/tOHZ/tOW/tWHZ at CL = 5 pF (+/-500 mV).

symbol_map.tWR: write recovery (address hold after end of write); there is no separate tAH

AS6C1008-55.conditions: Single AC table valid over VCC 2.7-5.5 V; same test conditions as AS6C62256 (50 pF + 1 TTL; Z-transition params at 5 pF).

AS6C1008-55.notes: Read/write numbers are identical to AS6C62256-55. IMPORTANT: since the July 2021 revision the DC table gives VIH min = 0.7*VCC (3.5 V at 5 V) and VIL max 0.6 V, i.e. NOT TTL-input compatible at 5 V: LS/S/F TTL outputs (VOH min 2.5-2.7 V) do not guarantee a valid high. Drive it from HCT/ACT/AHCT or use pull-ups. Has a second chip enable CE2 (active high).

symbol_map.tWR: write recovery (address hold after end of write); there is no separate tAH

AS6C4008-55.notes: Read/write numbers are identical to AS6C62256-55 and AS6C1008-55, but this sheet's AC test load is 30 pF + 1 TTL (those use 50 pF). Starred params (tCLZ, tOLZ, tCHZ, tOHZ, tOW, tWHZ) are guaranteed by characterization, not production tested. DC levels (v1.4) at VCC 4.5-5.5 V: VIH min 2.4 V, VIL max 0.8 V (TTL-compatible inputs, unlike the 0.7*VCC VIH of the 2021+ AS6C1008 sheet); VOH min 2.4 V at -1 mA, VOL max 0.4 V at 2 mA. Single CE# (no CE2). The 32-pin DIP uses the JEDEC 512Kx8 pinout: pin 1 = A18 and pin 30 = A17 where the AS6C1008 has NC and CE2; every other pin matches the AS6C1008. CE# and WE# must be high during address transitions. In WE-controlled writes with OE low, tWP must exceed tWHZ + tDW. If CE# goes low with or after WE#, the outputs stay in high impedance.
